briefdescription.para: Process a DAP setBreakpoints request for a single source file.

detaileddescription.para:
Replaces all existing breakpoints for rawSourcePath with the new set. For each requested breakpoint:
If symbols are available, resolves immediately via Session::addBreakpointByLocation.
If resolution fails (symbols not yet loaded), the entry is recorded with engineId == 0 and retried by onModuleLoad.
Old breakpoints for the file that are not in the new set are removed via Session::removeBreakpoint.

parameterdescription.para: Raw source path from the DAP client (may use any separator).
Array of DAP breakpoint objects, each with a "line" field.

simplesect.para: Array of DAP breakpoint response objects (verified/unverified, with resolved lines).

briefdescription.para: Attempt to resolve all unresolved breakpoints after a new module has loaded.

detaileddescription.para: Iterates the breakpoint registry and calls setBreakpointLocation for each entry whose engineId is 0. Successfully resolved entries have engineId and resolvedLine written in place.

simplesect.para: Array of DAP breakpoint changed event bodies for each newly resolved breakpoint. The caller is responsible for sending these as DAP events.

briefdescription.para: Build the DAP stopped event body for a breakpoint hit.

detaileddescription.para: Finds the tracked breakpoint whose engineId matches, then constructs a stopped-event body with reason "breakpoint" and the hitBreakpointIds array.

parameterdescription.para: Engine breakpoint ID from the Breakpoint callback.
OS thread ID of the thread that hit the breakpoint.

simplesect.para: DAP stopped event body object, or an empty object if engineId is not found.

detaileddescription.para: Called from processDeferredEvents when state.hasBreakpointLocationsResolved fires — typically when a module loads that resolves a BP created via Session::addBreakpointByLocation before the module was present.
Updates the stored BreakpointInfo::resolvedLine. Returns the DAP breakpoint ID so the caller can emit a DAP breakpoint event with reason=changed.

parameterdescription.para: The source line the engine resolved the BP to.

simplesect.para: Matching DAP BP ID, or 0 if the engineId is not tracked (e.g. spurious event for a BP we didn't create).

briefdescription.para: Return true if engineId belongs to a user-registered breakpoint.

simplesect.para: true if engineId matches a tracked breakpoint's engineId.

briefdescription.para: Return true if any tracked breakpoint has not yet been assigned an engine ID.
Resolve sourcePath:requestedLine to a target offset, without creating an engine breakpoint.

detaileddescription.para: Tries Session::getOffsetStatus / Session::getOffset, falling back to a forward search of up to lineSearchWindow lines if the exact line fails. Named and shaped after its siblings Session::getOffset (the value it resolves) and BreakpointManager::getBreakpointResponse (get returns, never stores) — the caller is responsible for calling Session::addBreakpoint on the returned offset.

parameterdescription.para: Backend-native source path for the engine's breakpoint query.
One-based source line number from the client.

briefdescription.para: Resolve entryInfo's pending breakpoint location and update it in place.

detaileddescription.para: Calls getBreakpointOffset to resolve entryInfo.sourcePath:entryInfo.line to a target offset, then creates the engine breakpoint via Session::addBreakpoint. On success, writes engineId and resolvedLine into entryInfo. No-op if resolution or breakpoint creation fails — entryInfo is left unchanged. Shared by addReloadedBreakpoints and onModuleLoad, which each apply the result differently.

parameterdescription.para: Breakpoint entry to resolve and update in place.

briefdescription.para: Remove breakpoints for normalizedKey that are no longer in requestedLines, and return the requested-line -> DAP-ID map for the lines that remain.

detaileddescription.para: Scans the primary breakpoint registry for entries whose normalized sourcePath matches normalizedKey. Entries whose requested line is not in requestedLines are removed from the engine (Session::removeBreakpoint) and from the registry. Entries whose requested line is in requestedLines are returned so the caller can reuse their existing DAP ID.

parameterdescription.para: Normalized source path key for the file being processed.
Set of requested lines from the current setBreakpoints call.

simplesect.para: Map of requested line -> DAP ID for breakpoints that remain registered.

briefdescription.para: Create and register a new breakpoint for a single requested line.

detaileddescription.para: Resolves via Session::addBreakpointByLocation, records the result in the primary registry under dapId, and returns the stored entry.

parameterdescription.para: Raw source path from the DAP client.
DAP breakpoint ID assigned to this entry.

briefdescription.para: Build the DAP setBreakpoints response object for a single breakpoint entry.

briefdescription.para: Force a global symbol reload and retry resolution for every unresolved breakpoint.

simplesect.para: Map of DAP ID -> BreakpointInfo for every entry newly resolved by this call. The caller rebuilds and replaces the matching setBreakpoints response entries via getBreakpointResponse.

briefdescription.para: Manages the full lifecycle of DAP breakpoints against a debug engine session.

detaileddescription.para:
Responsibilities:
Translate DAP setBreakpoints requests into engine breakpoint objects.
Retry unresolved breakpoints each time a new module loads.
Match incoming engine Breakpoint callbacks to DAP IDs for stopped events.
Remove stale breakpoints when a source file's breakpoint set is replaced.
The manager holds a reference to Session (does not own it). Session must outlive BreakpointManager.
